audit: P1.3a — BW vs Wenzl-bridge vs LP-shadow-price equivalence
claim: For self-conjugate partitions, the three derivation paths produce coefficients that are rationally related by explicit factors of h = q-q^{-1}: BW form β_λ = -w_λ/2; shadow-price C_λ = w_λ · h/2; Wenzl-bridge y_λ = w_λ for κ_λ = 0 (self-conjugate); ratios BW/shadow = -1/h, BW/Wenzl = -1/2, shadow/Wenzl = h/2.
conclusion: The three forms are NOT independent results. They are the same Wedderburn-block invariant w_λ scaled by explicit factors: BW supplies the unsigned mass coefficient (w_λ/2); LP shadow-price multiplies by h to give the LP dual variable; Wenzl-bridge tracks y_λ = ±w_λ with sign determined by the content sum κ_λ = Σ c(x). For self-conjugate λ (κ_λ = 0), y_λ = w_λ. No independent fits; all three are the same w_λ.
